pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with distinct but slightly blurred edge gradients. Larger spatial area on mid-flank transitioning to smaller, higher-density clusters on the hindquarters and lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous cream-colored network with frequent 3-way and 4-way junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-section, narrowing slightly in the anterior neck transition.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible jagged silhouette along the dorsal neck and shoulder line with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations against the background.
